title: fix(sdk): extract streaming fixes and missing request options
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Extracts SDK changes from #14472 so they can ship without the website redesign. Addresses #14472; remaining website work stays there.
- Uses eventsource-parser instead of custom SSE parsing. Requires standard event boundaries, discards incomplete events at EOF, and stops at [DONE] without inspecting trailing data.
- Keeps request values and provider payloads unchanged, including extra fields. Retains existing malformed-response/API-error checks and cancellation, including #14487. Adds routing, resolution options, response types, and alpha.7.
- All 51 client tests, typecheck, builds, and Biome pass. Full suite: 72/73 pass; the unchanged PKCE callback test still intermittently fails, as noted during the original extraction.
- No website, shared UI, backend, deployment, or secret changes. Credits Elliot for the extracted work.

gist.headline: Streams find their banks
gist.blurb: The SDK’s streaming creek now follows proper SSE boundaries instead of reading tea leaves from raw chunks. Extra request options also made it safely through the garden gate.
gist.summary: The SDK now uses eventsource-parser for standards-compliant SSE streaming, stops cleanly at [DONE], preserves incomplete-event behavior and cancellation, and exposes routing, resolution, response-type, and alpha.7 request options.
gist.impact: SDK users get more reliable streamed responses while provider payloads and extra fields remain intact, with routing and generation options available directly in typed client requests.
gist.visual_concept: Depict a tidy pixel stream of SSE event packets flowing through clearly marked stepping-stone boundaries into a cozy retro terminal, with a small [DONE] sign closing the channel. Polli, wearing tiny river-guide waders and holding a clipboard, watches the packets arrive intact while code-plants beside the terminal bloom with routing, resolution, and response-type tags.
